The structure of the course is based on the usability-oriented design process, where lectures, workshops and project-oriented-work are used to create an overall picture. Methods, theories and guidelines from interaction design research are presented.  Furthermore, theories, methods and techniques for usability-oriented design are taught.

Usability, user experience, the design process, user studies, usability goals, conceptual design, interaction techniques, usability evaluation.
